hostPorts.purpose: Creates Marketplace draft listings from committed import batch rows without Inventory depending on Marketplace implementation.

inventory-items.purpose: Own inventory item feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the inventory context.
inventory-items.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

import-batches.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

catalog-item-support.purpose: Provide reusable catalog-item-support assets shared by inventory-owned features and composition seams.
catalog-item-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
catalog-item-support.justification: catalog-item-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
catalog-item-support.createdFor: inventory workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
catalog-item-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.
